en: The Stonehearth Bunker is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Horde will destroy it!
%s's body falls to the ground, a lifeless heap.
You want to talk to Osborne then. No finer teacher of the stealth arts than him in Stormwind. Look for him over in Old Town.
Yes right away momma!
My faith guides my actions, $r. I know that Ivus will come.
We, the Alliance, will prevail!

I'm not here to teach babes fresh out of the cradle. Ye've nowhere near the amount of skill I require in my students. In fact, ye're a sad figure of a $glad:lass;, an' I'll thank ye not to stand there jibber-jabberin' at me.
Your jail is ours!
Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

I have long known you'd seek me out, $N.$B$BEvery sentient being in this world is driven by the choices they make.  Choices begat further choices, and these in turn make someone who they are.  This is where your fortune is drawn from - who you are, and the choices you make.$B$BAre you ready to discover where your fortune lies?
senses your fear.
Hey! Do you like the sauce? The sauce is good, no?
Welcome to the Explorer's League.  If you need information, and it is in book form, then I might be able to help you out.
I will not be lured from this place.
Glacial Gloves.
Too easy.
How do you like my pet?
I don't want to go back to work

Well now $n, let's get to work on those cauldrons!  If you're going to collect the components we need, then get a vitreous focuser from me.  You'll need to have it on you to identify the necessary resources found on the Scourge that will turn those cauldrons.$B$BYou'll also need a dose of arcane quickener for the cauldrons.  It's not cheap, nor is it stable.  Once you have it, you'll only have thirty minutes to use it before it expires on you; be smart about buying it.
Finally, free at last... I must be going now, thanks for helping me escape. I can get back to Freewind Post by myself.
Electric justice!
The people of Darkshire expect more from the Council.  We cannot let them suffer from this unholy wrath which plagues us.
%s examines the blood in the bottle.
It was simple once I broke her spirit.

The Shen'dralar were Queen Azshara's most revered arcanists. It was within these very walls that the Queen's most important demands were processed - often in secret.$B$BAfter the destruction of the Well and the subsequent lethargy that overcame the Highborne and lesser night elf sects, the Prince of Eldre'Thalas, Tortheldrin, began construction of the pylons that you see littering the halls of the west wing.
The secrets of Suntara will not leave these lands.
Will you blow up that door now?
I do what me can to train you in the priestly ways, if that what you be here for.

Is this the best they could do?$B$B<Omarion musters the strength to laugh.>$B$BYou do not possess the resolve to face a monster like Kel'Thuzad. You will crumble before his minions - just like those that have come before you...$B$BLeave me here to die. I refuse to return to a world that champions the likes of you.

Could it be? One that passes through these halls with a purpose? Aye, a righteous fire burns in your belly, $r.$B$BMy life may soon end, but the knowledge I hold must be shared with the world. It is, after all, why I am here now.$B$BAre you a master of a trade?

You won't learn anything new from me; you know too much already. If you want more training, talk to the tauren Una in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. Send her my regards, eh?
Pets to take care of?  Just make sure you clean up after it!  Look for Shoja'my in front of the inn.
I am sorry $c, but you need to be more powerful before I can allow you to enter Arathi Basin.
The Primal Gods? Impossible!
When the rep is talking to you, he will start each line with your name.  If you don't see your name, he's not yet speaking to you.
Gelman Stonehand would be the one to talk to. I think he has a house over in the Dwarven District but I can't remember exactly. I would check over there.

Ansekhwa, the tauren weapon master, is on Thunder Bluff's lower rise.  He can train one and two-handed maces, staves and guns.

Hanashi, standing next to me here, can instruct in the use of bows, one and two-handed axes, staves and all manner of thrown weapons.

Archibald, the undead weapon master in the War Quarter of the Undercity, can teach the use of crossbows, daggers, one and two-handed swords and polearms.
You... are next.
